description.zh: 要批量插入的数据，数据结构为array数组，每一项为一条记录
description.en: The data to bulk insert. The data structure is an array, where each item represents a record.

description.zh:
用于指向用户希望访问的资源，格式如下：```acs:rds:{{regionId}}:{{accountId}}:dbinstance/{{instanceId}}```

参数说明如下：

- regionId：地域ID，可调用[DescribeSecrets](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html)接口获取。
- accountId：阿里云账号ID，可调用[DescribeSecrets](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html)接口获取。
- instanceId：实例ID。
description.en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) that specifies the resource to access. Format: ```acs:rds:{{regionId}}:{{accountId}}:dbinstance/{{instanceId}}```

Parameter description:

- regionId: the region ID. You can invoke the [DescribeSecrets](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html) operation to obtain this value.
- accountId: the Alibaba Cloud account ID. You can invoke the [DescribeSecrets](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html) operation to obtain this value.
- instanceId: the instance ID.

description.zh: Data API账号的用户凭证，您可调用[DescribeSecrets](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html)接口获取该参数的值。格式如下：`acs:rds:{{region}}:{{accountId}}:rds-db-credentials/{{secretName}}-{{6 digits random string}}`。
description.en: The user credential of the Data API account. You can call the [DescribeSecrets](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html) operation to obtain the value of this parameter. Format: `acs:rds:{{region}}:{{accountId}}:rds-db-credentials/{{secretName}}-{{6 digits random string}}`.

description.zh: 需要提交的事务ID，您可调用**BeginTransaction**接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the transaction to commit. You can call the **BeginTransaction** operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

descriptions.zh: 本接口当前仅支持华东1（杭州）、华北2（北京）地域的Serverless实例使用。
descriptions.en: This operation is currently supported only by Serverless instances in the China (Hangzhou) and China (Beijing) regions.
